user.title: Set up BRUH Minecraft
user.description:
This integration talks to the BRUH Minecraft add-on running on this Home Assistant host. The add-on exposes sensors, buttons, and services for controlling your Minecraft server.

Server files live at `{server_dir}` and backups at `{backup_dir}`.

confirm.title: BRUH Minecraft discovered
confirm.description: Confirm setup to enable sensors, buttons, and services.

rcon_command.name: Run RCON command
rcon_command.description: Execute an arbitrary server command (no leading slash).

say.name: Broadcast chat
say.description: Send a chat message to all players.

give.name: Give item
give.description: Give an item to a specific player.

restart_server.name: Restart server
restart_server.description: Save worlds and restart the Minecraft server.

stop_server.name: Stop server
stop_server.description: Stop the Minecraft server (add-on stays running).

kick_player.name: Kick player
kick_player.description: Kick a player from the server.

ban_player.name: Ban player
ban_player.description: Ban a player from the server.

whitelist_add.name: Whitelist add
whitelist_add.description: Add a player to the whitelist.

whitelist_remove.name: Whitelist remove
whitelist_remove.description: Remove a player from the whitelist.

pardon_player.name: Unban player
pardon_player.description: Lift a ban on a player.

teleport.name: Teleport player
teleport.description: Move a player to another player, or to x/y/z coordinates.

player.name: Player
player.description: Who to move — a player name, or @a for everyone.

to_player.name: To player
to_player.description: The player to move them to. Leave empty to use x/y/z.

x.name: X
x.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

y.name: Y
y.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

z.name: Z
z.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Who is online right now, beside the last collected server stats. Returns response data.

get_world.name: Get world
get_world.description: What is going on in the world now - who is on and where, the time, day and weather, recent events, the last save and backup, and Vesper's builds. Returns response data.

list_builds.name: List builds
list_builds.description: Vesper's build log, newest first. Returns response data.

save_build.name: Save build
save_build.description: Add a job to Vesper's build log (give a title), or change one (give its id). A job set to done with bounds gets a top-down picture.

id.name: Job id
id.description: The job to change. Leave out to add a new one.

part.name: Part of the engine
part.description: Which part of the sentience engine this build is for (any label).

bounds.name: Bounds
bounds.description: The build's box: x1, z1, x2, z2, optional y1, y2 and dimension.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Anything worth keeping about the build.

image.name: Picture
image.description: A picture of the build (a /local/ path or URL), if not drawn from the world.

delete_build.name: Delete build
delete_build.description: Remove a job from Vesper's build log.

list_addons.name: List add-ons
list_addons.description: What the add-on browser can offer this server, and what is installed in the active world. Returns response data.

search_addons.name: Search add-ons
search_addons.description: Search Modrinth for server-side add-ons this server can run (every player gets them, Bedrock/iPad included). Returns response data.

install_addon.name: Install add-on
install_addon.description: Add a Modrinth project (and anything it requires) to the active world.

id.name: Project id
id.description: The Modrinth project id from search_addons.

remove_addon.name: Remove add-on
remove_addon.description: Take an add-on installed by the browser out of the active world.

get_vesper.name: Vesper's engine
get_vesper.description: Vesper in the game — whether it is on, the family roster, named zones, recent moments, questions, the action log (each undoable action) and what Vesper remembers about each person. Returns response data.

vesper_ask.name: Ask with choice pads
vesper_ask.description: Put a two-picture question to a child. Vesper builds a green and a red pad beside them with a picture above each; standing on one for two seconds is the answer, which goes into their memory. Asked the next time they play if they are not on.

player.name: Player or person
player.description: The in-game name (Bedrock names keep their dot) or the person's name from the roster.

question.name: Question
question.description: The question in words, kept for the parent; the child sees the pictures.

options.name: Options
options.description: Two options, each either a label, or an object with a label, a picture (a block id), a gift (an item) and a gift_count. Leave out for yes and no.

vesper_undo.name: Undo Vesper's action
vesper_undo.description: Put back what one of Vesper's actions changed in the world (blocks that still hold what Vesper placed, and its entities).

vesper_engine.name: Vesper's settings
vesper_engine.description: Switch Vesper in the game on or off (it is off until switched on), name the bedtime switch, and set how many things it may do a day. Each field is optional.

on.name: On
on.description: Let Vesper appear, greet the children and ask choice-pad questions.

bedtime_entity.name: Bedtime switch
bedtime_entity.description: An entity that means bedtime (input_boolean.kids_bedtime, bedtime while on), or an entity and the state to match (binary_sensor.boys_door=off). Empty for none.

daily_actions.name: Actions a day
daily_actions.description: The most things Vesper may do in the world in one day.

daily_chats.name: brAIn talks a day
daily_chats.description: How many times a day Vesper may ask brAIn for words in the game — a grown-up's greeting and each request a grown-up makes in chat. 0 keeps Vesper to its short built-in lines.

set_family.name: Set the family
set_family.description: Who plays and how Vesper treats them. A list of people, each with a person name, a role (child or reader) and their in-game player names.

set_zone.name: Set a zone
set_zone.description: Name a place in the world (x, z, radius). A protected zone is one Vesper never builds in; delete removes it.

rename_world.name: Rename the world
rename_world.description: Rename the active world to a name as said ("Vesper World"). The folder takes a safe form of it (Vesper_World) and the server list shows the name as said. Stops the server, keeps the backups, and restarts the add-on.

vesper_say.name: Say something as Vesper
vesper_say.description: Vesper says a message in the game's chat to one person on the family list, or to the family. It never tells one child about another, says nothing to anyone not on the list, and nothing to a child at bedtime.

to.name: To
to.description: A person's name or Minecraft name, or "family" (everybody from the family who is in the game).

message.name: Message
message.description: What Vesper says. Long messages are split over a few lines.

vesper_build.name: Build something small as Vesper
vesper_build.description: Vesper places up to 64 blocks, relative to a player's feet when a player is named. Only into empty space, on natural ground, never in a protected place or on or next to a build; logged, and undone with vesper_undo.

blocks.name: Blocks
blocks.description: A list of {x, y, z, block}, e.g. [{x: 2, y: 0, z: 0, block: oak_planks}].

player.name: Beside
player.description: A person or Minecraft name; the coordinates are then offsets from where they stand.

dimension.name: Dimension
dimension.description: For absolute coordinates (no player); minecraft:overworld unless given.

title.name: Title
title.description: What it is, for the log ("a little bridge").
